newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: STATE BUDGET IN SURPLUS OF 11.9 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: STATE BUDGET IN SURPLUS OF 11.9 MLN LITAS.

text.p: Lithuania's finance ministry said on Tuesday that improved revenue collection in April had put an 11.9 million litas surplus into the state's coffers.
The ministry earlier said that revenue collection had fallen 86.3 million litas short of target in the first quarter of the year.

"Today we compensated for previous shortages and now revenues exceed the planned target for the year by 11.9 million litas," the head of the finance ministry's treasury department, Vytautas Uziela, told Reuters.
"The state budget collected 571.99 million litas as of April 28 compared to the 521.22 million litas planned for the whole month," he said.
Uziela also said that the average daily revenue collection for the state budget in April was 28.6 million litas versus a planned target of 23.69 million litas.
The Lithuanian government has made improved revenue collection a top priority as it attempts to work within tight monetary and fiscal restraints.
